name: Newtown Apparel Company
old_description: Shirts, polos, hats, hoodies, sweatpants & everything else. From discount brands to top names like Under Armour, Nike, Adidas, Eddie Bauer & More.
about:
Newtown Apparel Company operates from Newtown, Connecticut, providing custom embroidery, screen printing, and promotional product services to businesses, schools, and teams. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders in the available materials.

The shop handles the full decoration workflow in-house: clients request a quote, the team refines artwork and sends a proof, then production runs on embroidery and screen-printing equipment before orders ship or are picked up. The company promotes access to thousands of blank styles from brands such as Under Armour, Nike, Adidas, Eddie Bauer, Carhartt, Yeti, and Callaway, and advertises a typical turnaround of one to two weeks, with rush options available. It also sets up and manages online company stores for recurring orders.

Customers include corporate buyers sourcing giveaways for trade shows, school and youth-sports programs ordering spiritwear, and local organizations needing team uniforms. The site notes the company has helped hundreds of organizations through the guided quote-to-delivery process.

Newtown Apparel emphasizes a "no-hassle" model that combines a dedicated account contact, free artwork assistance, and free online-store setup so clients can move from idea to finished goods without managing multiple vendors.
